baseline.verified: HEAD == main == G0, tracked tree clean at freeze time

objective: Demonstrate that ERLab can autonomously select and execute a second, materially different empirical capability through the same design → execution → persistence → synthesis → assurance → remediation → freeze → release architecture, with no capability-specific redesign of that lifecycle.

frozen_input.research_question: Are robust-regression method rankings stable as covariate perturbation severity increases, or do rank reversals occur in MAE, RMSE, and R² across tabular regression datasets?

datasets.name: concrete_strength
datasets.status: already registered at G0 (UCI, CC BY 4.0)

datasets.name: airfoil_self_noise

protocol_frozen.baseline_method: mean_predictor (training-set mean of target; predictions independent of covariates, so its metrics are severity-independent and reported once per dataset)
comparison_methods: ridge: closed-form ridge regression on standardized features (train statistics), lambda=1.0, solved by pure-Python Gaussian elimination — the non-robust reference
huber: Huber regression via iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS), initialized from the ridge solution, delta=1.345 x MAD-scaled residual spread, fixed 50 iterations — the robust method
protocol_frozen.covariate_perturbation: deterministic seeded Gaussian noise on test-set features only: per-feature zero-mean noise with std = severity x 0.5 x per-feature training std, seed fixed (42 + severity index); severities [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75]; no label noise
metrics: R2 (1 - SS_res/SS_tot about the test-set mean)
protocol_frozen.flat_metric_layout: 2 datasets x 4 severities x 2 methods x 3 metrics + 2 datasets x 3 baseline metrics (once per dataset, severity-independent) = 54 markers (count is an observation, not a criterion)
protocol_frozen.entrypoint: checked-in deterministic pure-Python analysis (experiments/tabular_robust_regression_v1/analysis.py), --input/--output -> metrics.json; no LLM-generated code, no external ML library
protocol_frozen.implementation_truth: method_facts frozen on the capability at declaration, transcribed from the entrypoint implementation (the Case-1 method-fidelity mechanism)

extension_surfaces_permitted: SupportedCapability declaration/registration (backend/pipeline/experiment/spec_designer.py capability definitions and a capability registry)
generic_seam_permitted_once_before_quali: ensure_autonomous_experiment_design() in backend/pipeline/stages.py: replace the hardcoded TABULAR_CALIBRATION_SELECTIVE_V1 selection with deterministic, fail-closed selection from registered SupportedCapability objects (0 applicable -> unsupported_capability; 1 -> select; >1 -> ambiguous_capability halt). SpecDesigner remains the compiler; the selector only chooses which declared capability contract it receives. This change lands alone as G1 with regression proofs that Case-1 behavior is intact.
core_lifecycle_protected: ExperimentResult persistence and autonomous result hydration (backend/pipeline/persistence.py, backend/pipeline/stages.py hydration)
cold repair architecture (backend/api/routes/ideas.py repair route, backend/pipeline/evaluation/paper_remediator.py, revision_directive.py)
the six paper-assurance gates (provenance, scope_alignment, conclusion_support, experiment_alignment, numeric_fidelity, method_fidelity) — no seventh gate

gate_sequence.G1: <SHA after C3-1 generic seam, Case-1 behavior proven intact>
gate_sequence.Q0: <SHA after C3-2/C3-3, CI green, hermetic composition proven>
gate_sequence.rule: After G1, adding Capability #2 may not require changes to protected lifecycle machinery. If it does, that is ARCHITECTURE FAIL evidence, not implementation work.

acceptance_criteria: 1. Capability breadth: qualifying run uses the regression capability, not the Case-1 classification capability
2. Autonomous selection: input is domain + question only; no explicit spec, no operator selection
3. Existing spec contract: Capability #2 compiles into the existing ExperimentSpec representation
4. Existing execution: all required experiments run through the common trusted execute_experiment_spec() path
5. Existing persistence/recovery: durable results; cold reconstruction recovers the complete expected set without Capability-#2 recovery logic
6. Existing synthesis/remediation: common empirical synthesis and cold-repair paths consume Capability #2 without a regression branch
7. Existing assurance: same six gates pass on the final artifact; no seventh gate
8. Method truth: released methodology matches the frozen Capability-#2 method_facts
9. Zero intervention: operator_interventions == 0; any human decision after launch disqualifies
10. Release authority: E == F == R == H; released bytes identical to frozen paper
11. Preservation: blocked/repaired/frozen revisions and failed states intact
12. Architectural generality: the G1 -> Q0 delta contains no capability-specific alteration of protected lifecycle machinery (architectural qualification criterion, not a paper gate)

failure_taxonomy.PASS: Capability #2 plugs into generalized architecture and completes the qualifying lifecycle -> close Case 3
failure_taxonomy.ARCHITECTURE_FAIL: Capability #2 requires capability-specific core lifecycle changes after G1 -> preserve evidence; the abstraction boundary is false
failure_taxonomy.RUN_FAIL: Architecture composed correctly but the frozen scientific/execution run fails -> preserve; investigate under frozen criteria
failure_taxonomy.INVALID_ATTEMPT: Environment/preflight violated frozen conditions -> preserve specimen; correct environment; fresh attempt
failure_taxonomy.GENERIC_PRODUCT_DEFECT: Common-path bug, not capability-specific design need -> preserve; smallest generic fix; re-freeze Q0; new attempt
failure_taxonomy.DIFFERENT_SCIENTIFIC_RESULT: Results differ from expectations -> not a failure

out_of_scope: persistence migration absent a demonstrated generic blocker
state_taxonomy_note: C3-5 preflight uses the Case-2 three-class taxonomy: research state fresh; required operating state preserved (model certification, model assignments, provider config, governed datasets, capability registration); optional/reconstructible state may be absent only where the system is designed to tolerate it (recorded as diagnostics, e.g. EmbeddingProfile rows).

c3_1_review_addendum.trigger: PR #18 automated review (chatgpt-codex-connector) raised two P1s before G1 froze.

finding_1.title: Classification-only synthesis directive in protected paper-context builder
finding_1.detail: PaperSynthesisStage._build_autonomous_paper_context() hardcoded "The paper must describe the actual calibration/selective-classification capability..." — a capability-specific branch inside the protected synthesis surface. Left in place, the C3-2 regression capability would have required a capability-motivated protected-lifecycle change, producing a false ARCHITECTURE-FAIL verdict under criterion 12.
finding_1.resolution: Recorded as a seam-scope extension permitted BEFORE qualification: the directive now comes from the capability contract (new SupportedCapability.paper_directive field) through the design state; the builder uses it with a capability-generic fallback. The calibration capability carries the byte-identical original text, so Case-1 synthesis behavior is unchanged.

finding_2.title: Single broad signal could select a capability
finding_2.detail: select_capability() treated any one signal substring hit as applicable: "confidence intervals for protein folding" matched the corroborating "confidence" signal and would have selected the classification capability.
finding_2.resolution: Stronger-evidence rule: applicable = at least one task-family signal hit (new SupportedCapability.family_signals) OR >= 2 distinct corroborating signal hits. Single-corroborating-only inputs now fail closed as unsupported_capability.

c3_1_review_addendum.g1_note: G1 was not yet frozen (PR #18 unmerged) when these fixes landed; both are part of the single permitted generic-seam change set.

finding_3.title: Regression family signal must not collide with logistic-regression classification inputs (PR #19 review)
finding_3.detail: Once the regression capability is registered, a bare "regression" family signal would make "compare logistic regression classifiers" hit BOTH families (classifier -> calibration; regression -> regression) and halt as ambiguous. Logistic regression IS a classification method; the correct route is calibration alone.
finding_3.resolution: Signal-design constraint frozen now, no selector change: the C3-2 regression capability will use non-colliding family bigrams — ("tabular regression", "robust regression", "regression datasets", "regression method", "regression task", "regression analysis") — none of which occur in logistic-regression classification phrasing. Enforced by test_c3_1 capability-selector TestRegressionFamilyDisambiguation with a fake regression capability using exactly this frozen signal list: the Case-3 input routes to it, "compare logistic regression classifiers" routes to calibration alone.
